# Call setup failures and dropped sessions at S-TUN-016

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-TUN-02-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Multi-site onset and topology match LNK-TUN-02-B as the shared link, but direct transport alarms are absent.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-16 03:30 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-16 03:30
- **Affected:** S-TUN-016, S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005

## Summary

Transport degradation on fiber link LNK-TUN-02-B affecting S-TUN-016, S-TUN-004, and S-TUN-005 starting at 03:30.

Call setup failures and dropped sessions rose at S-TUN-016 and sibling sites S-TUN-004 and S-TUN-005 starting at 2026-09-16 03:30.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-16 03:30: Alert ALR-0016 and RRC success rate drop begin on S-TUN-016. [ALR-0016, ANM-000185]
- 2026-09-16 03:42: Configuration push templates applied to S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005, and S-TUN-016. [CHG-2026-0043, CHG-2026-0044, CHG-2026-0045]
- 2026-09-16 04:18: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-TUN-016. [ALM-000247]
- 2026-09-16 04:20: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-TUN-005. [ALM-000248]

## Evidence

- Alert ALR-0016 and earliest KPI onset began at 2026-09-16 03:30 on S-TUN-016, S-TUN-004, and S-TUN-005. [T1, T5]
- Configuration pushes occurred at 2026-09-16 03:42, which is after the KPI degradation onset. [T4, T5]
- Other sibling sites sharing aggregator AGG-TUN-02 showed no deviations. [T14]
- No maintenance was scheduled on the affected nodes or their parents. [T7]

## Inferences

- The affected sites S-TUN-016, S-TUN-004, and S-TUN-005 share LNK-TUN-02-B as their lowest common parent. [T2]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-TUN-02-B: confirmed. Shared link LNK-TUN-02-B connects all affected sites while other sibling sites remain healthy. [T2, T14]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-016: rejected. Configuration changes occurred at 03:42, whereas KPI degradation started at 03:30. [T4, T5]

- CHG-2026-0045: Occurred at 03:42, which is 12 minutes after the onset of the KPI degradation at 03:30.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect fiber link LNK-TUN-02-B for intermittent packet loss or degradation.
- Review site logs for S-TUN-016, S-TUN-004, and S-TUN-005 around 03:30.
